testName: Change Data Capture (CDC) Event Publishing & CometD/gRPC Replay ID Check
steps:
1. Subscribe external test listener client to CDC channel "/data/AccountChangeEvent"
2. In Salesforce, open Account record and update Phone to "+1 555-888-0022" and Industry to "Finance"
3. Click on Save button
4. In listener client, verify incoming CDC event payload is received
5. Verify header 'changeType' equals "UPDATE"
6. Verify payload contains only modified fields: 'Phone' and 'Industry' (delta payload)
7. Verify sequential 'replayId' is present for reliable disaster recovery replay
